motion_attribution: C must additionally meet that same >=0.01/no-AP95-loss rule against B-CONTROL
fine_only_screen: If no frozen SSL recipe qualifies, B full fine-tuning qualifies when AP50 is strictly above matched published full fine-tuning and AP50:95 is not lower. budget: Reserve measured final roster cost before optional motion/replication; preserve at least6h. Keep omitted replications explicit if the complete paired forecast cannot fit. No additional architecture/configuration search.
status: Prospective author development decision rule, not a significance claim
